_README: SAMPLE ONLY: the small summary artifacts from one real testnet run, trimmed. Produced by: npm run index -- --enrich-limit 800 --trade-window 200000 --burn-window 2000000 --compare-api. NOTE: this sample predates three things that current runs emit: run.rpcEndpoint, run.foreignActivity, and the whole of output/activity.json (the indexed-transaction count). They are absent here because this run happened before they existed, not because they are optional. This run's trade scan was a 200k-block window in any case, so it could not have produced a lifetime transaction count. The figures have deliberately NOT been regenerated or back-filled.

retired.evidence: VERIFIED ONCHAIN: direct TOTAL_FEE_BPS() reads on 6 curves returned 100; 126/126 indexed non-dust trades matched 100 bps at a 5000 bps creator share, within 2 wei. NET_GRADUATION_TARGET() read 5e15. quoteCurrency() reverts (function absent).

legacy.evidence: VERIFIED ONCHAIN for fee and split: TOTAL_FEE_BPS() reads 125 on enriched gen2 curves and 28,805/28,805 indexed non-dust trades matched 125 bps at 7500 bps. Graduation target and virtual reserve NOT read for this generation; left null rather than assumed equal to gen3.

current.evidence: VERIFIED ONCHAIN: TOTAL_FEE_BPS() constant across 2,499 enriched curves; 63,473/63,473 indexed non-dust trades matched 125 bps at 7500 bps.

buybackBurn.note: Two legs. Pre-graduation, transfersUnlocked()==false prevents a transfer to 0x...dEaD, so bought-back tokens are HELD in the launch CreatorVault. Counting only the burn address under-reports supply impact.

sanityChecks.name: total fee matches each generation's policy
sanityChecks.observed: 35669/35669 within 2 wei [current:25302/25302@125bps, legacy:10197/10197@125bps, retired:170/170@100bps]; 81 dust trades (<1000 wei gross) excluded; 0 on generations with no observed policy

sanityChecks.name: creator/protocol split matches each generation's policy
sanityChecks.observed: 35669/35669 within 2 wei [current:25302/25302@7500bps, legacy:10197/10197@7500bps, retired:170/170@5000bps]; 81 dust excluded; 0 unknown-policy

sanityChecks.name: pre-graduation buybacks are held in vault, not burned
sanityChecks.observed: 800 projects examined; 673 locked-with-vault-holdings, 0 locked-with-burn (must be 0), 2 unlocked-with-burn

sanityChecks.name: TOTAL_FEE_BPS is uniform within each generation

apiCrossCheck.note: OPTIONAL cross-check. Never a source of truth.

corsPolicy.conclusion: Server-side reads work; browser reads from a third-party origin are blocked at the edge. A third-party web app needs its own proxy.

_SAMPLE_IS_HISTORICAL.why: Real output from a real run on 2026-09-13, kept as a shape reference. Not regenerated for the 2026-09-17 validation run, and deliberately not hand-edited.
